name: Maggots X14

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Auspex
bonuses.text: As a Combat Action, Maggots can detect energy emissions, motion, and other life signs within 50 metres.

bonuses.name: Mag-Boots
bonuses.text: Maggots can walk on any metallic surface, but his speed is reduced by 3 if walking at an angle of more than 45 degrees to the plane of gravity.

abilities.name: Weaponised Ignorance
abilities.text:
Spend 1 Ruin. Maggots presses a few buttons on his heavily modified suit of armour, and one of the following effects occurs at random:
- Antigrav Field: Maggots gains a speed of 12 Flight until the end of his next Turn.
- Refractor Field: Maggots's Resilience increases by +3 until the end of his next Turn.
- Electro Generator: Every creature within 5m takes 12 + 2 ED damage (Agonising) and must make a DN 5 Toughness Test. On a failure, the creature is Restrained for 1 Round, and knocked Prone on a Complication.

note: Omnissian Axe prints 'Range 2' and no traits; stored [2]. Faction imperial: hive scum gang leader.
